title: ssh: Handle entire hostkeys-prove array
description:
The "hostkeys-prove@openssh.com" message has an array of multiple
hostkeys. Handle all of them, intead of just the first. They're also
hostkeys, so dissect them as such.

This can be checked with some of the recent sample captures, e.g.
in !19912
